note: Render-time content flags for surfaces whose data is committed but whose launch is gated. Law (ADR-CLASS-0001 practice, adapted to content): a flag key or course slug that is ABSENT means OFF — nothing renders; flipping one key kills the surface without a deploy of code. This file gates rendering only; it never fabricates data (a flagged surface with no committed bundle still renders its honest empty state).
